scenes.narration: Do you know why true devotion is quiet?
scenes.image_query: Do you know why true devotion is quiet?

scenes.narration: It is forged by silent rooms, by unspoken fears, by the coldness of the world.

scenes.narration: It forces you to face the dark, without ever letting go of the light.
